title: Page/view visibleWhen publishes has(status) and has(record.items[0]) clean, then the console faults and fails open: adopting that check() verdict needs the maintainer's ruling (follow-up to #25267)
body:
Ruled: 6351260886 · letter A · 2026-10-22T21:04Z

**Filing gate ③**, a follow-up owed by landing work. It was filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549), `os-bill`, session `session_01B2EeooonSXrANpkpgUSfFZ`, from out-of-scope finding 1 in the `os-dev-report` `6349466484` on #25267. Contract review `6349699572` on PR #25275 answered it as **maintainer**. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## The gap (measured at `baf8e2254`)

- `validateVisibilityPredicates`, the page/view `visibleWhen` door of `os validate`, returns 0 findings for `has(status)` and for `has(record.items[0])` on a page component. The control `record.x === 1` does fire `visibility-predicate-syntax`.
- `celEngine.evaluate` faults `has() invalid argument` on both, so the console fails open.
- These are the two argument shapes the CEL spec itself refuses (a bare name; an index as the last step). PR #25275 fixes every other `has()` receiver shape; it leaves these two refused, as it should.
- The `cel-engine.ts` docblock above `firstUndeclaredReference` already records the `has(status)` half as STILL OPEN.

## Why this needs the maintainer

Closing it means the page/view rule adopts one more `check()` complaint. Ruling #13594 reserves that: 「只拒未知函数裁定,⛔ 不搬运 `check()` 的其他抱怨。」 So the first step is a ruling on whether the page/view door may refuse these two shapes at publish, not code.

## Ask

A ruling: adopt the `has() invalid argument` verdict on the page/view `visibleWhen` rule (and then a card to implement it), or keep the #13594 boundary and record why the fail-open is accepted.

Dedupe: searched issues for "has() invalid argument visibleWhen page", "has bare identifier publish clean" and "has index last step"; no open carrier. **New.**
